findings.title: AssignmentSource.queued default is evaluated once at class definition, not per instance
findings.body: The field `queued: datetime = timezone.now()` is a plain dataclass default, so `timezone.now()` is called exactly once at class body evaluation (i.e. at module import time) and the resulting `datetime` is reused as the default for every instance that does not override it. As a result, two `AssignmentSource` objects constructed at different times will share the same `queued` timestamp, defeating the apparent purpose of the field (recording when the source was queued/created) and producing misleading data in any log line, analytics event, or future debugging code that uses `queued`. The fix is to use a per-instance factory: `queued: datetime = field(default_factory=timezone.now)` (with `from dataclasses import field`). The existing `test_to_dict` only asserts `queued is not None`, so it does not catch this regression.

findings.title: No test for deassign cycle prevention, only assign is covered
findings.body: The PR adds `test_assignee_sync_outbound_assign_with_matching_source_integration` to verify that `GroupAssignee.objects.assign` does not call `sync_assignee_outbound` when the assignment source equals the target integration. The symmetric path, `GroupAssignee.objects.deassign` invoked from `sync_group_assignee_inbound(..., assign=False)`, now also accepts an `assignment_source` and propagates it through `sync_group_assignee_outbound`, but there is no test asserting `mock_sync_assignee_outbound.assert_not_called()` for the deassign case. Because both code paths were changed in this PR, both should be covered to prevent the same loop being reintroduced on unassign flows.

findings.title: Typo in test method name: 'inalid' should be 'invalid'
findings.body: The test is named `test_from_dict_inalid_data`, which is a misspelling of 'invalid'. This will make the test harder to discover when searching for invalid-input coverage and is a small but clear documentation defect in the test file.
